title: Told facts
description: GENERATED by `node tools/story/story.mjs build` (tools/story/lib.mjs#toldFactsFile): the words of every fact a canon scene's beat says out loud (a beat's `facts`, never its `gmFacts`), keyed by fact id. The Scene Runner's 'What the table knows' drawer (module core/table-knows.mjs) lists the ones the table has heard so far this episode. `story check` fails when it is out of date; never edit it by hand.

facts.description: Fact id (canon/world/<entity>.md heading) to its words.

text.description: The fact's text, as canon/world states it.

about.description: The title of the world file it comes from: who or what it is about.
